_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Engine Control System Component Test Report Requirements
summary: The Engine Control System Component Test Report Requirements describe the format and content of deliverable information from environmental qualification testing of engine control system components for airworthiness authority approval.
use_relationship:
The Engine Control System Component Test Report Requirements describe the format and content of deliverable information from the environmental qualification testing of engine control system components. It provides clear and complete instructions for the preparation of qualification substantiation data products to be submitted for approval by the airworthiness authority, resulting from applicable tasks delineated in the solicitation.
a. This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in 5.10.4.1 of MIL-STD-3087.
b. This DID supersedes DI-NDTI-81897.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, if any, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: List of Tables.
preparation_instructions.content: When used in a separate series, tables shall be given Roman numerals.

children.title: Figure numbers and captions of all illustrations.
Photographs, charts, and graphs shall be treated as illustrations and given figure numbers.

children.content: Any non-conformances shall be described here, with reference to 17. Appendix A for the actual detailed documentation of such, including any corrective action taken. The report shall explain the rationale for testing a nonconforming part or reworked part. Airworthiness Authority approval of the non-conformances shall be included in Appendix A.

children.title: Test Plan Summary
children.content: Summarize the test plan in a table, including the order of testing, the name of the test, the test procedure, and the test plan paragraph number.

children.title: Plan Approval
children.content: Specify when/how the Airworthiness Authority approval of the test plan was provided and include in 18. Appendix B the documentation of such.

children.title: Deviation to the Test Plan (Global)
children.content: Explain any global deviations to the test plan that had to be made and reference Appendix B for the documentation of the deviations, along with Airworthiness Authority approval.

preparation_instructions.title: Test Readiness Review (TRR).
preparation_instructions.content: Indicate if a TRR was held. Provide information on whom, when and where, and the outcome of the TRR.

children.title: Include documentation of Airworthiness Authority approval to test.
Include TRR materials in 19. Appendix C.

preparation_instructions.title: Test Summary.
preparation_instructions.content: Include a table similar to the one illustrated below. Acronyms in the table above are defined as follows: ATP - Acceptance Test Procedure; N/A - Not applicable; S/N - Serial Number; UUT - Unit Under Test.

preparation_instructions.title: Individual Test Summaries.
preparation_instructions.content: For each of the tests listed in the table of item 13, provide in separate test subparagraphs, each beginning at the top of a new page, the following information. These summaries are typically 2 to 4 pages in length each, but may be exceeded as necessary to adequately cover the required information.

children.title: Significant events that occurred or relevant observations.
Test procedure errors made or deviations taken.
The effect, if any, of (a) and (b) on the test outcome or results.
Pass/Fail criteria that were not met and the significance of the failure.
Proposed remedies or design changes as a result of failures.
Any other relevant information.
Statement on whether or not the Unit Under Test (UUT) met its qualification test objectives.
Each disassembled part or subcomponent shall be discussed in detail as to: condition with respect to a new part, continued usability, and likelihood of impending failure.
Photos of each part or subcomponent must be clear and in color; photocopied pictures are not acceptable if they do not provide adequate detail.
Include all material discrepancy actions, plus any other documentation of unit nonconformance.
Documentation of Airworthiness Authority approval.
Documentation of Airworthiness Authority approval.
Documentation of Contractor approval.
Documentation of Airworthiness Authority approval.
TRR presentation or other material.

preparation_instructions.title: Appendix D - ATPs or Calibrations Conducted During Testing.
Appendix E - Individual Test Reports and Results.
preparation_instructions.content: Individual reports shall be included in separate 'tabbed' sections. Note that these reports shall not duplicate any of the information provided up through item 20, unless absolutely necessary.

children.title: The report shall be organized to generally follow the approved test procedure.
Photographs of all test equipment and test setups shall be included.
Environmental test conditions shall be documented.
Detail the conduct of the test, including a chronological history of events and incidents connected with the test.
A complete analysis of results shall be included, and any pertinent performance/calibration data for illustration purposes.
Clearly highlight (as illustrated in the table below, including reference to applicable data sheets) and discuss in detail any test anomalies, and propose any remedies, if necessary.
Tables and charts shall be utilized to clearly present and summarize the test data.
children.content: Data for an entire test, presented in the example tabular format below, has been deemed acceptable in most cases.

children.title: Component condition at test completion shall be detailed or discussed, and conclusions and recommendations rendered.
State in the test report whether component performance and function are within established limits.
children.content: State in the report whether the component under test exhibited any fluid leakage and if fluid leakage is of a nature and rate specified in the engine or component specification. Hang-ups or hesitations of any component, if any, shall be described in the report.

children.title: State in the report if recalibrations indicate that no component has changed its calibration beyond allowable service limits.
State in the test report if the component teardown inspection shows indication of failed, excessively worn, and distorted parts.
children.content: Measurements shall be taken and compared with engineering drawing dimensions and tolerances or with similar measurements made prior to the test.
